opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel and subsistence up to £2,000 per person for trips up to 13 days and £2,500 per person for 14 days or more; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. UK projects apply to the UK office; Japan projects to the Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits across arts and culture, humanities and social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per award; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference given to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applications particularly welcomed. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including the study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
